title: Beach You To It Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutBeach You To It ~ 119 Hickory Street ~ Seagrove Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 20% Discount off Spring Break and Spring Rates! 4-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. Beach You To It, constructed in 2023, is a luxuriously appointed home featuring 3,495 square feet of indoor/outdoor living. Comfortably accommodating 12 guests, Beach You To It offers 5 bedrooms, 4.5 baths, hardwood flooring throughout, tasteful lighting and artwork, high ceilings, stunning coastal interior design, 8'x20' private heated saltwater pool (heating fee applies), multiple outdoor porches and driveway parking for 4 vehicles. Located in Old Seagrove, Beach You to It is a quick stroll into Seaside and about a 2-minute walk to the Hickory Street beach access. On-street parking is not allowed; please plan accordingly. Ground Floor: 1 bedroom. 1 bath. Living room. Dining table seats 6. Island seating for 3. Powder room. Laundry room. Screened porch. #1 En-suite (Master) bedroom has a King bed, full bath with walk-in-shower, double vanity Second Floor: 4 bedrooms, 3 full baths. Screened balcony. #2 Bunk room has two built-in bunks (4 Twins) - Please note there is no door from the hallway to the bunkroom entrance. #3 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, walk in shower Full bath with walk-in shower, shared by #2 and #4 bedrooms #4 Bedroom has a King bed #5 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, walk in shower. *Please note – All TVs are Smart TVs with no local channels, streaming services available with guest account login. Amenities: Business Features Hi Speed Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 6 Flat Screen TVs (all are Smart TVs with no local channels; streaming services available with guest account login) Distinctive Features Private heated saltwater pool (heating fee applies) 2-minute stroll to Hickory Street beach access Bed, bath, kitchen linens provided Beach Gear Credit General Features Driveway parking for 4 vehicles (on-street parking is not allowed; please plan accordingly) 4 King beds, 2 Built-in Bunks (4 Twins) 4 full bathrooms, powder room, iron, ironing board, 4 hair dryers, wet bar, outdoor gas grill w/ grill utensils, outdoor shower, screened porch, screened balcony, porch furniture. Ring Doorbell Camera on Front Entrance Door. Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. *PLEASE NOTE - It is not recommended to heat the pool in colder weather, as heaters will not be able to heat to the desired setting as ambient temperatures fall below 50 degrees. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen with marble counter tops, stainless KitchenAid appliances including gas range, French door fridge with ice maker, dishwasher, microwave, farmhouse sink, coffee maker, Keurig, toaster, blender, washer, dryer, separate ice maker, beverage fridge. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) Seaside (7/10ths mile) Grayton Beach (2.5 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake
